name: Waterskin
bonus: +1 to endure heat, thirst, or a long climb.

name: Shovel
bonus: +1 Brute to dig, pry, or turn over a heap.

name: Hammer
bonus: +1 Brute in a fight, and to break something small.

name: Rope, 50 ft
bonus: +1 to any climb, and to lower someone down a shaft.

name: Quill and ink
bonus: +1 Erudite to copy a map, a rune, or a room number.

name: Crowbar
bonus: +1 Brute to force a door, a lid, or a gibbet.

name: Parasol
bonus: +1 Skulker to break a fall or hide what you are carrying.

name: Rose incense
bonus: +1 Erudite to call, calm, or bargain with a spirit.

name: Black mallet
bonus: +1 Brute for smashing stone, doors, and idols.

name: Lock pick
bonus: +1 Skulker on locks, latches, and cages.

name: Lantern
bonus: +1 to see anything that is not blue.
note: Lit, you are the most visible thing in the room.

name: Tusk spear
bonus: +1 Brute, and long enough to keep a pelican at arm's length.

name: Shield
bonus: +1 to block, brace a door, or shelter someone.

name: Torch
bonus: +1 Skulker in the dark.
note: It burns out when the referee says so.

name: Bear trap
bonus: +1 to hold a doorway against something heavy.

name: Compass
bonus: +1 Erudite to work out which way a window really faces.

name: Mirror
bonus: +1 to look round a corner without being the thing that gets looked at.

name: Rations
bonus: A meal each.
note: Eaten somewhere quiet, or not at all.

name: Cloak
bonus: Your colour, your choice.
note: Pick blue and nobody sees it after the first hour. Including you.

name: Knife
bonus: +1 in a close fight. Everyone has one.

name: Twin knives
bonus: +1 Brute or Skulker in a knife fight. Name which before you roll.

name: Light crossbow
bonus: +1 Skulker at range.
note: One bolt, then a moment spent winding. Armour does not help.

name: Brass spyglass
bonus: +1 Erudite to read a distant window number or count giants.

name: Bag of salt
bonus: +1 against anything made of water, and it hates being thrown.
note: Also preserves fish, and marks a floor you have already crossed.

name: Grappling hook
bonus: +1 to catch a chain from a window ledge.

name: Chalk
bonus: +1 Erudite to keep track of rooms you have already walked.

name: Flask of oil
bonus: Burns, or makes a floor treacherous. Pick one.

name: Ring of water breathing
bonus: Breathe water indefinitely.
note: Room 1, on a skeletal finger. Drowning stops being one of the ways this tower can kill you.

name: Defender's blade
bonus: +1 Brute, and +1 again when you are fighting for someone else.
note: Room 7, in the font.

name: Plate armour
bonus: Absorbs 2 damage. -1 Skulker. Break one piece a hit, three times.
note: Room 7. Most of a suit. The rest is still in the fountain.

name: Venomous quills
bonus: Thrown, Skulker DS 8. A hit does 4 extra as the venom works.
note: Room 9, lodged in a pelican jawbone.

name: Potion of leaping
bonus: One enormous jump. Window to window, or roof to boat.
note: Room 9, under the jawbone.

name: Circlet of clear sight
bonus: The wearer sees blue.
note: Rooms 16-17, in a silver sack. Sky-blindness does not touch you. Nobody else will believe what you describe.

name: Sack of silver
bonus: A year's wages.
note: Two hands, or a strap, and a bad climb.

name: Silver drinking bowl
bonus: A month's wages.
note: A giant's cup. The size of a shield.

name: Smoked lake-fish
bonus: Restores 2 HP if eaten somewhere quiet.

name: Cut chain, 12 ft
bonus: +1 to climbs, and jams a door shut.
note: Heavy. Rust comes off on everything.

name: Torn tower map
bonus: Shows three rooms in the correct order.
note: Which three is the referee's business.

name: Sword
bonus: +1 Brute in a fight.
note: Nothing else, and nothing less.

name: Spear
bonus: +1 Brute, and you reach them a step before they reach you.

name: Maul
bonus: +1 Brute, and it goes through what a sword stops at.
note: One swing, then you are wide open.

name: Mace
bonus: +1 Brute, and armour does less for the one you hit.

name: Quarterstaff
bonus: +1 Brute at arm's length, and +1 to hold a doorway alone.
note: Also a pole, a pry bar, and a depth gauge.

name: Hand axe
bonus: +1 Brute in reach or thrown. Splits a shutter as well as a shield.

name: Sling
bonus: +1 Skulker at range.
note: The ammunition is the floor.

name: Bow and quiver
bonus: +1 Skulker at any range you can see across.

name: Crossbow
bonus: +1 Skulker at range.
note: One shot, then a long moment spent winding it.

name: Mail shirt
bonus: Absorbs 2 damage. -1 Skulker.

name: Leather armour
bonus: Absorbs 1 damage.

name: Padded jacket
bonus: Absorbs 1 damage.
note: Quiet, and nobody looks twice at it.

name: Net
bonus: Entangles up to four who stand close. Brute DS 10 to get out.

name: Bola
bonus: Thrown, Skulker DS 8. Whatever it takes is slowed, not stopped.

name: Caltrops
bonus: Scatter a patch. Anything crossing it slows and bleeds.
note: Picking them back up is its own job.

name: Thieves' tools
bonus: +1 Skulker on locks, and on any trap you have already found.

name: Healer's kit
bonus: +1 Erudite to treat a wound, and 1 HP back if the roll lands.
note: A wound treated once is not treated again.

name: Field-prayers
bonus: +1 Erudite to steady someone who is about to break.
note: A book of them, much rained on.

name: Holy token
bonus: +1 to hold your nerve against the dead.
note: Worn smooth by one thumb.

name: Spell components
bonus: Anchors a spell that lingers: the effect stays after the book shuts.

name: Wand of city-glass
bonus: Once a day, read a spellbook a second time and take no Fatigue.
note: Glass cut from a wall that was a street. It hums near spellbooks.

name: Hooked chain
bonus: +1 to trip, disarm, or drag something off a ledge.
note: Cut from a window chain by someone who was in a hurry.

name: Executioner's blade
bonus: +1 Brute, and +1 again against anything larger than you.

name: Bone dagger
bonus: +2 against someone who has not seen you, armour no help.
note: Roll 6 or less on the dice and it snaps off in the wound.

name: Rusted ringmail
bonus: Absorbs 1 damage.
note: Break it to cancel one hit outright. It was going to fail anyway.

name: Tower shield
bonus: +2 when you do nothing but take cover behind it.

name: Flask of acid
bonus: Eats through a lock, a hinge, or a suit of armour. No roll.

name: Pouch of grave-dust
bonus: Thrown in the eyes: blinded, and the next ally to strike gets +2.

name: Iron spikes and hammer
bonus: Seals a door well enough to rest behind it.
note: The only way this tower gives anybody a night's sleep.

name: Pocket hourglass
bonus: Stops one tick of one of the referee's clocks.
note: Sand that has run out and gone back up again.

name: Corpse tooth
bonus: Erudite DS 10 to ask a dead body one question. Yes or no.
note: It answers in your own voice, which is the worst part.

name: Wolf-skin cloak
bonus: +1 Skulker in cold, wind, or weather. Counts as your cloak.

name: Unsettling idol
bonus: A month's wages to the right buyer.
note: Nobody rests well in the room where it is sitting.

name: Vial of black blood
bonus: Restores 4 HP at once.
note: Roll 2d6. On 6 or less something about you changes and stays changed.

name: Cracked hand-mirror
bonus: +1 Erudite to look at something you must not look at directly.

name: Goblin's tooth-pouch
bonus: The shaman wants it back badly.
note: Leverage, if anyone works out what it is for.
